description: Northern Province - The Supplementary Provision for Appropriation Statute No. 04 of 2015 and the Notification of the adoption of Statute
reasoning: This gazette content enacts a supplementary appropriation statute (Statute No. 04 of 2015) for the Northern Provincial Council, authorizing the re-allocation and expenditure of funds. It creates legal provisions for financial matters and follows a statutory enactment process, making it primarily a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change.
